posts.name: tiun.
posts.tagline: Auth, billing, and payments for AI builders
posts.description: One system for auth, payments, customer data, and analytics. One command to install. Launch a paid product the same day you start building.

posts.name: Kilo Code for iOS and Android
posts.tagline: Start coding agents, control sessions, review PRs. Anywhere.
posts.description: Run Cloud Agents, control VS Code and CLI sessions, review Pull Requests, and respond to coding agents from your iPhone, iPad, or Android.

posts.name: Voiskey
posts.tagline: AI voice typing that sounds right in every app
posts.description: Voiskey starts from what you meant, not just what you said. Speak a rough thought and it comes back shaped for where it's going and who's reading it: casual with a friend, composed with a colleague, technical with an AI. It arrives 5x faster than typing, cleaned up and ready to send, while you still sound like you. Voiskey is now available on iOS, macOS, Android, and Windows, in over 100 languages. It's free to start. Join during launch and get a free month of Pro.

posts.name: siift
posts.tagline: Turn AI noise into better business decisions
posts.description: Building a business with AI can quickly become a mess of chats, tools, ideas, and conflicting advice. siift turns that noise into a living map of your business, connecting strategy, evidence, decisions, and results in one place. From validation and build strategy to GTM and growth, our AI uses your evolving business context and proven processes to challenge assumptions, identify risks, and help you focus on what matters next.

posts.name: Anthropologic
posts.tagline: The zero distance consumer research platform.
posts.description: Traditional research is deep but slow. Social listening is fast but shallow. LLMs are fluent but culturally blind. Anthropologic reads the whole internet through our 'Human Context Protocol' to uncover consumer, category and cultural truths. Nine workflows, 239 markets, 100+ languages. Research, innovation and foresight answers in minutes.

posts.name: Axari
posts.tagline: Assign your security busywork to your AI twin
posts.description: Your Axari AI twin understands your security world, works across your tools and teams, and keeps work moving until it is actually done. Assign it a goal, let it work proactively, or give it recurring responsibilities – all from within Slack or MS Teams. Attackers aren't going to use less AI, neither should you. You + your AI twin = indefatigable.

posts.name: OpenAI Agents API
posts.tagline: Cloud agents, run on OpenAI's Codex harness
posts.description: OpenAI's managed version of the Codex harness to build cloud agents with one API call instead of your own orchestration. Handles long sessions, smart tool use, and subagents working in parallel. Runs on OpenAI or partner sandboxes. No extra fees beyond token and tool usage. Open source harness, public beta now.

posts.name: PeekPaste
posts.tagline: Your clipboard, within reach
posts.description: PeekPaste is a native clipboard manager for Mac that stays out of your way until you need it. Push your pointer against the screen edge and your clipboard slides in. Find text, code, links, images, colors and files, search inside screenshots with on-device OCR, pin and organize clips, or open the full Library when you need more. Everything stays on your Mac - no accounts, analytics, telemetry or cloud clipboard service.

posts.name: Narrative
posts.tagline: AI-first video editor, just describe edits & refine in chat
posts.description: Narrative brings video editing, custom motion graphics, and reference-video style matching into one interface. Upload your footage, describe your edit, and keep refining through chat. Add music, sound effects, and transitions, or get inspiration from reference videos. From podcast clips to launch videos, create without learning Premiere or After Effects. We handle rendering and storage. Our launch video was made entirely in Narrative.

posts.name: DynamicLake 2.0
posts.tagline: Dynamic Island for Mac with 3rd Live Activities and more
posts.description: DynamicLake - Dynamic Island for Mac · Plugins · Notifications · Drag and drop · Converter · Calls · Airdrop · Timer · and more

posts.name: Buddy AI Access (MCP)
posts.tagline: Your agent needs more than your repo
posts.description: Give AI agents secure access to your infrastructure and workflow. With Buddy MCP agents can run pipelines, inspect logs, deploy apps, create sandboxes, publish artifacts and manage domains. Control exactly what they can access with workspace permissions and tool scopes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and other MCP clients.

posts.name: FATHER
posts.tagline: A Mac dashboard for site traffic, deploys, uptime, and SEO
posts.description: A mission-control dashboard for teams shipping on Vercel. Connect your account and every project fills in live: traffic, deploys, uptime, and PageSpeed scores. Search Console and Bing show clicks, rankings, and indexing. SSL and domain renewals get a countdown, and failing GitHub checks get flagged. When a build fails, the menu-bar F turns red and a notification fires, even with the window closed, so you know a site's down before your clients do. Tokens stay on your Mac. One-time purchase.

posts.name: Mac Duo
posts.tagline: Turn your display into frosted glass as you close the lid
posts.description: A macOS app that turns your display into frosted glass as you close the lid. Driven by the hinge sensor, so it moves at the speed of your hand.

posts.name: Thoughts for Mac
posts.tagline: Capture notes from your menubar using text, images or voice
posts.description: Thoughts is a menubar app for your Mac which helps you keep notes quickly using text, images and voice. Add your favorite agent API key and it'll also help transcribe audio, context images to text and help do simple text-tranforms like capitalization, translations and spelling fixes. Think of it as a fun small multi-tool for your menubar.

posts.name: The Minimalist Entrepreneur Skills
posts.tagline: Book playbook as Claude Code slash skills
posts.description: The Minimalist Entrepreneur as 10 open-source Claude Code skills by Sahil Lavingia. Install the plugin, then run slash commands like /validate-idea, /mvp, /pricing, and /minimalist-review to apply the book to your own business. Free and MIT-licensed on GitHub.

posts.name: Idlen
posts.tagline: Earn while you work with AI in any IDE or browser
posts.description: Developers wait on AI all day. That wait is an ad slot. One network, three doors. If you code: install the VS Code, Cursor or Chrome extension. A native ad while the model thinks. You keep 70%. We don't read your prompts. If you sell a developer tool: you show up in the IDE and the browser, targeted by the stack they actually use (React, Python, AWS). Pay €200, get €400 this week. If you shipped a chat app: npm i @idlen/chat-sdk. Three lines. Ads optional. No key, no ads. You keep 70%.

posts.name: Proofrr
posts.tagline: One workspace for creative feedback, reviews, and approvals
posts.description: Feedback in WhatsApp. Versions in Drive. Approvals lost in email. The review process eats into the actual work. Proofrr is one workspace for creative projects, client feedback, and version control. ✓ Project management for design & video workflows ✓ Side-by-side draft comparison ✓ Annotations & threaded comments ✓ Shareable review links — no client login needed ✓ AI-assisted reviews to speed up feedback

posts.name: Workshopy.io
posts.tagline: Turn a Markdown file into a live, trackable workshop
posts.description: Write a workshop as one plain Markdown file and run it live. Students join with a code - no accounts - and you see which step everyone is on: who's stuck, who's done, who needs help. Polls, quizzes, chat and a session report built in. Free, no credit card.

posts.name: Multimodal Agents by Sierra
posts.tagline: AI agents that switch between voice, text, and visuals
posts.description: Sierra's multimodal agents bring voice, text, and visuals into the same customer conversation. Voice is for explaining what you need, a visual for comparing options side by side, and text for referencing something later. Instead of picking just one, the agent automatically shifts between modes as the conversation needs.

posts.name: is.team
posts.tagline: Your AI agent joins the board like a teammate
posts.description: is.team is an infinite canvas where AI agents and your team plan, build, and ship together — visually. Drag kanban boards and notes onto a spatial workspace. AI agents join via MCP as real teammates — creating tasks, joining conversations, and shipping work alongside your team. Built-in voice rooms, real-time collaboration, GitHub/Slack/Calendar integrations. $16/mo flat for 15 people. Free to start, no credit card needed.

posts.name: Tangerine
posts.tagline: Offline file modifier for Mac
posts.description: Tangerine is a Mac app for converting files simply with Shift-drag. Hold Option for advanced tools. Convert and compress images, videos, audio, PDFs, and archives, remove metadata, redact documents, and annotate photos. All locally, without uploading your files.

posts.name: Grimo AI
posts.tagline: Say it once and all tasks, calendar and notes are sorted
posts.description: Grimo AI turns one spoken or typed sentence into tasks, calendar events, and notes — no forms, no switching apps. Say the words and Grimo files it exactly where it belongs, dated and prioritized. Built for messy weeks: a calendar that shows overlaps at a glance, hands-free voice mode for when your hands are full, and one chat thread so nothing gets lost across five different apps. Free to start. iOS only.

posts.name: Mailyte
posts.tagline: Email for your team, your app, and your customers.
posts.description: Mailyte is the only platform combining team inboxes, transactional/API email, and marketing campaigns in one place — on your own domain. Most teams stitch together Workspace, Postmark, and Mailchimp; Mailyte replaces all three. It's also open source (AGPL-3.0): self-host free on your own hardware, or let us manage it — same product, no lock-in either way. Built-in SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks and a live delivery view keep your mail out of spam, out of the box.

posts.name: Kodro
posts.tagline: Code robots in an offline Python learning simulator
posts.description: Kodro turns robotics learning into one visual loop: Design → Code → Simulate → Prove → Build. Students can assemble robots, program them with Python or blocks, test them in interactive 3D worlds, inspect live sensors and export evidence, all offline-first. Teachers get 24 curriculum lessons plus a lesson creator, while makers can prototype without expensive hardware. No account, cloud connection or AI is required.

posts.name: Payflip
posts.tagline: Pay anyone you can name. No IBAN, no wallet address.
posts.description: Payflip is a dollar wallet with usernames. Send USDC or USDT to an email, @handle, phone or QR. The recipient picks how to receive, and if they don't claim it, the money comes back to you. Non-custodial. Fee shown before you send.

posts.name: jurniti
posts.tagline: Always-on AI agents in Firecracker microVMs
posts.description: jurniti is a private always-on box for your AI agent. Each agent gets its own Firecracker microVM with a KVM hardware boundary, the same primitive AWS uses for Lambda, not a shared Docker container. Bring your own model keys. They stay inside the guest. Pay, and the box is live in about three minutes: in-browser terminal, persistent disk, your subdomain. Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, and other upstream agents. From $25/mo. 30-day money-back on the first purchase. No free trial.

posts.name: Fifi
posts.tagline: An alarm that calls you, and reads you your day
posts.description: Most alarms are a sound you silence. Fifi is a call you answer. It rings through Silent mode and a Focus — built on iOS 26 AlarmKit, so the alarm needs no network. Your Lock Screen shows an incoming call with a face and a name. Answer, and one of ten characters reads you your day: last night's note, your forecast, your headlines. An ASMR whisper, a film-noir detective, a nature doc, a drill sergeant, a pantomime baroness, a fairy godmother. 39 ringtones. A backup call. A streak.

posts.name: PortAura
posts.tagline: See what’s listening on your Mac
posts.description: PortAura is a native macOS utility that shows which processes are listening on which ports, where they’re exposed, and what has changed since your trusted baseline. It helps you understand local services without digging through Terminal commands. Everything runs locally on your Mac.

posts.name: Portfolio Frame
posts.tagline: Frame, annotate, and export screenshots that look designed
posts.description: Portfolio Frame turns plain screenshots into polished, share-ready images, right in your browser. Capture a full tab, a code selection, or a single element, then add device mockups, backgrounds, and annotations (including a redact tool for blurring out secrets before you share). Export instantly as PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or SVG. Free to use, no account needed. Built for developers and designers who want their work to look as good as it actually is.

posts.name: Shotbase
posts.tagline: The last Screenshot & Screen Recording  Tool You'll Need
posts.description: Beautiful screenshots, recordings, and more with private AI running on your Mac to organize it all. Capture, edit, organize, and share screenshots and recordings from one fast, streamlined workflow. We offer a 7-day free trial - No Credit Card required We are also offering a 25% Launch discount for a limited time on both Monthly and Yearly plans - Applied to all checkouts!

posts.name: JFrog Boost
posts.tagline: Save AI tokens & sharpen your coding agents
posts.description: Boost is a free, local-first CLI that compresses noisy tool output before it reaches Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or GitHub Copilot. Save tokens without changing workflows. Instead of blind truncation that breaks agents, Boost uses a shift-right, retrieval-backed approach. If your agent truly needs the raw logs, it can fetch them instantly. Standout features include: 1. Context-Aware Noise Compaction 2. BoostGraph 3. File Optimization 4. Agent Observability & Telemetry 5. Enterprise-Grade Privacy

posts.name: Smackdab CRM
posts.tagline: Not Your Grandpa's CRM. An AI Sales Suite for Our Generation
posts.description: Smackdab is the fun, friendly, all-in-one CRM. Bring back the joy of building relationships, managing your pipeline, and closing deals. FREE for three users.

posts.name: Things To Have
posts.tagline: A calm wishlist app for you and your friends
posts.description: Calm wish list app for you and your friends. Minimal, feature-rich, easy to share, privacy friendly and completely free

posts.name: Oren
posts.tagline: Build a reading habit that actually lasts
posts.description: Oren is a minimalist book tracker and reading companion for people who want to finish the books they care about, not just collect them

posts.name: Saferlayer
posts.tagline: Protect ID scans with watermarks AI can’t erase easily
posts.description: When someone asks for a photo of your passport or driver license, that copy can end up somewhere you never meant it to. Last week, millions of driver’s license scans tied to a big-company ID-check vendor were reportedly put up for sale. Saferlayer stamps yours with a watermark much harder to remove than a normal one, even with AI. Runs in your browser. Nothing uploads. Free to start. Pro adds PDFs, batch, and unique traceable copies. API for companies protecting stored files.

posts.name: BrandPrix
posts.tagline: Race your startup to the top of the leaderboard
posts.description: Race free in your browser, then publish a lap as yourself or your startup. Chase the leader's ghost, climb the leaderboard, and share your replay. Desktop + keyboard. Unlimited racing; $10 per published result.

posts.name: Spectry
posts.tagline: See what’s stopping users. AI tells you what to fix.
posts.description: Most analytics tools tell you what happened, then leave the fixing to you. Spectry closes the loop. Analytics, session replays, heatmaps, funnels, surveys, error logs, and A/B tests all run from one script. Every 12 hours, AI scans your data, identifies what’s costing you conversions, and turns each finding into a ready-to-run A/B test. Approve the fix, send it to real traffic, and see whether it actually works. EU-hosted and GDPR-first. Free plan: 5,000 sessions/month.

posts.name: Onyatrips
posts.tagline: The way travel should be.
posts.description: Onyatrips is building a meaningful travel discovery network connecting People, Places, Experiences, Communities and Trips. Our first product, Travel Companion, helps you find people worth traveling with through shared interests, college, profession, travel style, destination, budget and vibe — across individuals, groups and communities. Places is coming next: helping you discover trusted places and extraordinary experiences you never knew existed.

posts.name: LinkedMash
posts.tagline: Your LinkedIn saves, searchable and ready to post
posts.description: You save gold on LinkedIn - threads, frameworks, case studies then never find them again. LinkedMash turns those saves into a searchable library, then helps you ship: draft with Lina in your voice, schedule to LinkedIn, and plug the same library into Notion, Sheets, or your AI agents over MCP. Built by the Tweetsmash founders. 1300+ creators. 1.6M+ posts saved. Free 7-day trial, no card.

posts.name: WeekSync
posts.tagline: A planning tool for creative teams
posts.description: WeekSync is a simple resource planning tool for creative teams — without the enterprise overhead. Plan workloads and projects, spot over- and under-capacity, and turn scheduling data into reports for better staffing decisions. It also combines team planning with personal goals and to-dos across multiple time horizons. And unlike most planning tools, you can manage WeekSync directly from ChatGPT, Claude, or any AI agent via API.

posts.name: Verity
posts.tagline: Know what changed on your Mac.
posts.description: Verity is a native macOS app that watches the places installers touch: shell startup files, SSH, LaunchAgents and executable folders. Every change comes with a severity score, the reasons behind it, the possible process chain, and an encrypted history you can bring back. Optional Protect asks before selected new or changed executables run: Block, Allow Once, or Always Trust. Local-first, no telemetry. macOS 15+, signed and notarized. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: RiiS
posts.tagline: See what’s happening worldwide through people on the ground
posts.description: RiiS helps people understand what is happening around the world through first-hand photos, videos and reports shared by people who are there. Explore events on an interactive map, follow situations through updates, and help assess the reliability of reports through community verification. Contributors may have the opportunity to earn money by licensing selected content to media organizations under agreed terms. RiiS is in public beta and improving through user feedback.

posts.name: Product-Led Experience
posts.tagline: Design your product's growth flywheel, stage by stage
posts.description: AI makes building an app easy. Getting people to find it, use it, and stick around is the hard part — and most builders bolt marketing on after launch. PLX helps you design growth into the product itself. A canvas walks you through each stage of adoption: who it's for, what to measure, and which features, content, and messaging move users forward. The AI Coach rejects vague answers — you leave with build-ready elements, not theory.

posts.name: TrackingCoder
posts.tagline: Set up website tracking in 2 minutes, not 2 hours.
posts.description: Easily track and monitor every event on your website. Paste your URL. We scan your site, build your tracking and add it to Google Tag Manager in one click. Send the data to GA4, Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads and more. For solo Marketers and Agencies: ✓ Real-time event monitoring + insights and anomaly alerts, so you know before your client does ✓ Events by traffic source: prove which channel drives each conversion ✓ White-label client reports + a shared team workspace

posts.name: Finny
posts.tagline: The expense tracker that logs itself
posts.description: Nobody fails at budgeting. They fail at logging. Finny makes the log take seconds, sometimes zero. Automatic Apple Pay logging. Screen capture that logs whatever transaction is on screen, whether it's a bank transfer, a receipt, or a message. Or just say it out loud. Your bank's data, without ever linking your bank. 150+ currencies, one clear total in your home currency.

posts.name: Limurse
posts.tagline: Run creator campaigns from discovery to payout
posts.description: Limurse gives brand teams one system for creator discovery, outreach, briefs, approvals, deliverables, agreements, payouts, and campaign intelligence. Instead of rebuilding context across spreadsheets, inboxes, and agencies, teams keep every creator relationship and campaign decision connected. Creators get clearer opportunities, deliverables, and payment tracking in the same workflow.

posts.name: DOG ME app
posts.tagline: See Yourself or Your Friends as Dogs
posts.description: The Dog Me app turns a photo of a person into their very own dog lookalike! It’s simple and paw-some: 1. Snap a picture of yourself or a friend. 2. Create a unique dog that matches their look and personality. 3. Share your new doggänger with your pack. Each Pawtrait is generated by AI based on the original photo, transforming human features, expressions, hairstyles and accessories into a one-of-a-kind dog. What would you look like as a dog?

posts.name: VoiceTaking v2: The meeting note taker
posts.tagline: Transcribes your meeting, without bots joining your call
posts.description: Every other meeting note taker sends a bot into your call. VoiceTaking doesn't. You're already in the meeting, so it captures it right from your browser — meeting audio and your mic on separate channels, transcribed live and multilingual, so the notes always know who said what. Pick a template and the summary takes that shape, with action items, owners and due dates. Meet, Zoom, Teams, Discord. Desktop app coming soon!

posts.name: GlassNudge
posts.tagline: The Mac reminder you can't ignore
posts.description: GlassNudge is a Mac menubar app for reminders you won't miss. Set them manually, or bring your own AI key and describe them in natural language. When a reminder fires, a fullscreen overlay makes sure it doesn't get lost in the notification center.

posts.name: Orbit Analytics
posts.tagline: Analytics for all your websites in one cookie-less dashboard
posts.description: Orbit Analytics brings all your websites into one clean dashboard. No more jumping between tools or juggling multiple analytics accounts, see traffic, top pages, and referrers for every site in a single view. Privacy-first by design: no cookies, no consent banners, no complex setup. Just add a lightweight script and you're tracking. Built for developers and indie makers who run multiple projects and want clarity without the clutter

posts.name: EmberCine
posts.tagline: AI film studio + streaming platform for quality AI films
posts.description: EmberCine is both a studio and a streaming platform for AI-made films. Creators chat with a Director AI to turn an idea into characters, shots, a timeline and a finished film with trailer. Only quality AI-generated films make the catalogue: every film is reviewed before it goes live. Viewers stream a curated library; creators earn a share of subscription revenue by watch-time. We're pre-launch. Join the waitlist as a creator or a viewer and help us get the first films made.

posts.name: ProxyBox Zero
posts.tagline: Securely connect web apps and AI agents to local devices
posts.description: ProxyBox Zero turns local USB and network devices into secure HTTPS API endpoints that web apps and AI agents can use. Need to print? Just POST to a single endpoint from your browser or backend. No local print drivers and no weird browser workarounds. Use it on your local network, or securely from anywhere. Your devices stay local and do not need to be exposed directly to the internet.

posts.name: ha
posts.tagline: Serious vocal training for an objectively ridiculous goal
posts.description: Most laughs are apologies: clipped, breathy, and aimed at the floor. ha. treats yours like a motor skill. Laugh into your iPhone; on-device DSP grades attack, cadence, separation, voicing, and commitment, then gives you exactly one thing to fix. Scores drive a completely serious net-worth ladder from Intern to Jeff Bezos. Practice until 100, unlock a gold app icon at 80, and leave with the laugh of someone who has never worried about taking up too much air. Free, private by default, no ads.

posts.name: Thally
posts.tagline: The product knowledge layer for software teams
posts.description: Most documentation tools give you somewhere to write. Thally also keeps what you wrote true. When a product pull request merges, it works out exactly what changed, traces the impact across your docs, website, and support platform, then opens evidence-backed PRs for your team to review. It is also a complete, AI-native docs platform with Git-based content, deploy previews, search, analytics, custom domains, self-hosting and a remote MCP server.

posts.name: Ailin¹
posts.tagline: Collective Intelligence: The Next Frontier of AI
posts.description: Ailin¹ Collective Intelligence is an open-source artificial intelligence engine where a collective of 98,822 AI models that can collaborate, debate, critique, and synthesize together, applying structured diversity to problems where a single model is a single point of training, architecture, bias, and failure. This is not multi-model routing. This is not an API gateway. This is Collective Intelligence.

posts.name: Jalebi
posts.tagline: Your repos. Your agents. Your rules.
posts.description: Self-hosted coding-agent dashboard for GitHub work. Drives 10+ local CLIs in isolated git worktrees, with a live timeline, file changes and console, PR reviews, webhook triggers and merge gating. Localhost-only, free and open source.

posts.name: Glass Money
posts.tagline: Track UPI, banks, and joint accounts in one place
posts.description: Glass Money is personal finance for how India actually spends. UPI, cards, salary, joint accounts, and banks that never show up on Account Aggregator, in one private place. Built from the alert emails your banks already send. Read-only. No SMS. No bank login. Limited beta, free.

posts.name: Vibe Adventures
posts.tagline: Small-group guided travel packages worldwide, booked easier.
posts.description: We’re launching a platform for real-time booking of multi-day guided travel packages in minutes. Unlike traditional online travel agencies, which have historically focused on flight-and-hotel packages, we use APIs and proprietary technology to dynamically match 6,000+ instantly confirmable small-group tours from vetted operators in 125+ countries with global flights. Travelers can compare full trip prices, avoid multiple sites, and book flights, activities, stays, and other add-ons in one flow.

posts.name: PrivacyScanPDF
posts.tagline: 100% private PDF utilities and C2PA checker
posts.description: PrivacyScanPDF is a browser-first document toolkit running locally via WASM. Strip metadata, detect hidden PII, convert formats, and verify C2PA signatures without uploading files to any external server. Because all file processing occurs strictly on your device, it ensures complete compliance for sensitive legal, medical, and financial data.

posts.name: SeoMap
posts.tagline: See where your business ranks on Google Maps
posts.description: SeoMap maps Google Maps rankings across a service area with geo-grid heatmaps. Compare nearby competitors and share results with clients. Built for local SEO agencies, freelancers and local businesses. Plans start at EUR 29/month excluding VAT. Try it with 500 one-time credits, no credit card.

posts.name: Qalaris
posts.tagline: Slow down and learn Arabic calligraphy — reed pen + AI
posts.description: Qalaris turns your Apple Pencil into a real reed pen — not a brush. Flat-cut nib with real ink physics: the angle turns with your wrist, ink runs dry as you write, and pressure drains it faster the harder you press. Draw a letter, tap Analyze, and AI reviews your stroke like a master's red pen — red for errors, green for what's right. It marks up your own drawing, not a generated "perfect" one. Slow, mindful strokes make it a calm, meditative practice. The first AI calligraphy teacher for iPad.

posts.name: Hupmapper
posts.tagline: Everyone's arguing if AI wrote it. We measure what you added
posts.description: AI writing is everywhere. But whether AI was involved isn't the interesting question anymore. What matters is what you brought beyond it. Hupmapper scores any piece of writing from 0–300 based on how far it goes beyond what AI alone would produce. Paste in a memo, essay, email, or post and get your Originality Intensity score and fingerprint in seconds. See what makes your writing distinctly yours. Free public beta. No account required. Not an AI detector. An originality measure.

posts.name: Pyx
posts.tagline: Private investment research, built 100% in Rust
posts.description: Pyx pulls everything an investor looks at into one place: your brokerage accounts, live prices, time weighted returns, ETF look-through, a full charting workspace, and a decade of financials and SEC filings for any company. All of it lands in a single encrypted file on your machine, with no account and no cloud. From there it is yours: open it with sqlite3, export CSV, keep notes as plain markdown, or hand it to the AI you already use through the built-in local MCP server.

posts.name: Shareboxed
posts.tagline: A better way to share files, powered by your own storage.
posts.description: Shareboxed makes sharing files and folders simple, fast, and beautiful. Add your files, upload, and share it with a single link. Whether you're sending work to a client, sharing assets with your team, or delivering files to anyone else. And with Bring Your Own Storage, your files don't have to live on Shareboxed. Connect your own storage provider and keep control over where your data is stored, while Shareboxed handles the sharing experience.

posts.name: AgentDrive by Token Canopy
posts.tagline: "Google Drive" for your AI agents
posts.description: AgentDrive is a persistent file and workspace layer for AI agents. Store artifacts, organize folders, track revisions, upload larger files directly, and let agents work through the hosted MCP integration. Many file formats are supported: MD, HTML, JSON, images, videos, and even spreadsheets It’s a private beta, so some features are deliberately out of scope for now. API/SDK integration and open source are on the roadmap so that you can use AgentDrive in your own products or on your own infra.

posts.name: Do Not Build
posts.tagline: Know if a software market is worth your next year
posts.description: You get a few real attempts at building a company. Pick the wrong market and you burn a year finding out. Do Not Build measures the field before you commit: who's already there, what a customer costs, what it couldn't measure, and the founders circling the same market. So the year goes on a choice, not a guess — and if it works, it becomes a company instead of a lesson. The verdict is where you start, not the decision. 245 screened, 64 cautions at the build line.

posts.name: IceVault — Encrypted Local Database
posts.tagline: Private, encrypted database — no cloud. iPhone & iPad.
posts.description: IceVault is a private, offline database for iPhone and iPad — no account, no cloud, no tracking, encrypted on-device. Design your own fields (text, dates, money, photos, TOTP and more) and IceVault builds the list and detail views. Share a whole folder of data, or just its template — no data — with anyone, even as a download link, not just AirDrop. Comes with 20 templates. Every feature is free; IceVault Pro is a one-time $24.99 unlock, no subscription, that removes the 3-folder limit.

posts.name: IntellQ by Apavin
posts.tagline: Your Website Just Got Intelligent.
posts.description: See who is on your website right now, what brought them there and what they are reading, then talk to them in a chat window you can shape to the pixel, sized separately for desktop and phone. Unlimited seats for USD 15 a month.

posts.name: PDFZento
posts.tagline: Private PDF tools that run entirely in your browser
posts.description: PDFzento is a privacy-first, free all-in-one PDF toolbox with 53 tools for everyday document workflows. Everything is processed directly in your browser using client-side WebAssembly — your files never need to leave your device, with zero document uploads. Convert, compress, merge, split, edit, sign, organize, protect, redact, OCR, inspect, compare, and batch-process PDFs, including PDF↔Word, Excel, JPG, PNG, WebP, Markdown and EPUB workflows. Fast, private, and free.

posts.name: Vibe BI
posts.tagline: The Looker Studio alternative for agencies who outgrew it
posts.description: Vibe BI syncs GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads & Search Console into one ClickHouse-powered dashboard — no GA4 API quotas, no surprise BigQuery bills, no manual calculated fields. Reports load in milliseconds, not seconds.

posts.name: Bakemark
posts.tagline: A calm, ad-free home for the recipes you actually make
posts.description: Recipe sites have become impossible to use: life stories before the ingredients, popups between every step. Bakemark is the opposite. Paste any link, drop a PDF, or snap Grandma's handwritten card and AI turns it into a clean recipe on your shelf. Scale servings, cook hands-free with voice mode, and build offline shopping lists as you go. Share any recipe as a beautiful ad-free page friends can save to their own shelf in one tap. Free on iPhone, Android, and web.

posts.name: HonestHook
posts.tagline: Exact social data from 9 platforms, one API
posts.description: One API for public profile data from Instagram, TikTok, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, SoundCloud, Mastodon, GitHub and Linktree. One key, one schema. Returns the exact number on the page — never the rounded one. 1,000 free credits/month, no card. $9/mo.

posts.name: Pulse Monitor
posts.tagline: Group Heart Rate Monitoring System
posts.description: Pulse Monitor turns group fitness classes into an engaging, data-driven experience. Designed for fitness clubs and spinning studios, this Windows app tracks real-time heart rates, training zones, and calories burned for multiple participants at once. Boost motivation and keep your members hooked with live target zone metrics on a big screen.

posts.name: Nuggetz
posts.tagline: AI interviews your team and turns know-how into handbooks
posts.description: Nuggetz turns your team’s unwritten know-how into practical handbooks. AI conducts interviews and asks follow-up questions, while colleagues answer by voice or text in their own language. It compares answers to flag contradictions and missing knowledge. Handbook instructions link back to interview evidence, so you can check the source. Share handbooks by link or export them for your knowledge base and AI tools.

posts.name: HAGGIN
posts.tagline: The third button on your pricing page. Make an offer.
posts.description: Every SaaS pricing page has two buttons: Buy now and Talk to sales. HAGGIN is the third: Make an offer. Buyers propose a price, seats and extras like a testimonial. You accept, counter or pass from an inbox. Your list price never moves.

posts.name: Syntfluence
posts.tagline: Lock your AI character's face once, render forever
posts.description: One AI character, kept consistent across everything you post. Lock her face once and every photo, clip and voice line renders against that same anchor. Paste a reel that performed and get back the shot list that would rebuild it — free, tokens only when you render.

posts.name: Website Scroll Video
posts.tagline: Stop making website scroll videos manually
posts.description: Paste a link and get a smooth scrolling video of the page. MP4, WebM or GIF, in any aspect ratio, with cookie banners removed automatically. Free.

posts.name: Mentro - Focus with a companion
posts.tagline: Timer with an animated companion that blocks tabs
posts.description: Most Pomodoro timers just count down. Mentro puts an animated companion in your browser that reacts the moment you drift: it calls out off-task tabs, blocks them, groups the rest by task, and calls you back after breaks. Six companions, three free. No ads, no trackers.

posts.name: Dish Hound
posts.tagline: Discover it. Hunt it. Eat it. Collect it.
posts.description: How much of the world have you eaten? Dish Hound turns your food history into a real-world food adventure. Build your collection from 100 iconic dishes, reveal your Foodie Type and culinary blind spots, discover what you’re missing, then hunt those dishes down near you, eat them and grow your collection.

posts.name: Goblin Card RPG: Tower Trials
posts.tagline: 100 floors. One deck. Permadeath roguelike for iOS.
posts.description: A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder for iOS and Android. Climb a 100-floor tower as a goblin scavenger - five archetypes, permadeath runs, no two decks alike.

posts.name: My Dock Buddies
posts.tagline: Little 3D companions for the top of your Mac's Dock
posts.description: My Dock Buddies puts small, stylized 3D characters on top of your Mac's Dock. Not a 2D desktop pet: Max and Avery are fully animated 3D buddies who walk, work at a tiny desk, carry things, react and nap. Click one side and they run that way; click the middle and they stop, think and look up at you. Drag them along the Dock, or keep them in their spot. A native menu-bar app for macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel.

posts.name: Accountable
posts.tagline: Goal management with money on the line.
posts.description: Goal management with money on the line. Complete goals to keep your money (else, it goes to charity). Save a card (no charge upfront), set a deadline, and mark complete when you've reached your goal. Or, forfeit and the stake is queued to Society of St. Andrew.

posts.name: tokenstat
posts.tagline: Your coding agents, projects and AI usage, wherever you are
posts.description: tokenstat runs your coding agents in real git workspaces on your Mac, then hands you the machine from an iPhone or iPad: its screen, its terminals, SSH to your servers, chat with a running agent. Encrypted between your own devices. Free locally.

posts.name: Safebird
posts.tagline: The AI Assistant That Makes Insurance Agents Irreplaceable
posts.description: Safebird is the AI assistant built specifically for insurance sales professionals, covering the entire customer journey from first lead to long-term portfolio management. It qualifies leads, documents consultations, and grows customer intelligence in one place.

posts.name: Goblin Card RPG: Tower Trials
posts.tagline: 100 floors. One deck. Permadeath roguelike for iOS.
posts.description: A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder for iOS and Android. Climb a 100-floor tower as a goblin scavenger - five archetypes, permadeath runs, no two decks alike.

posts.name: Sugar Sense
posts.tagline: Your glucose on every screen: phone, watch, desktop, browser
posts.description: Sugar Sense reads your CGM (Libre, Dexcom or Nightscout) every 5 minutes and puts your glucose on every screen: iPhone, Android, Apple Watch, Wear OS, Garmin, Mac menu bar, Windows tray, browser, CarPlay and Alexa. Alerts arrive even while the phone sleeps: urgent lows can break through Silent, a forecast warns before a low, and Call for Low rings you, then an emergency contact. Family follows live with Care Circle. Monitoring, alerts and following are free forever. Dose-free by design.

posts.name: TRLoom
posts.tagline: Fine-tune LLMs with one YAML file on Hugging Face TRL
posts.description: TRLoom turns Hugging Face TRL fine-tuning into a single YAML config. Describe your model, dataset, trainer, W&B, and optional Modal GPUs — then run one command. `pip install trloom` `trloom run config.yaml` `trloom run config.yaml --modal` Built for ML engineers and researchers who want SFT, DPO, GRPO, and more without rewriting boilerplate every experiment. Open source (Apache 2.0).

posts.name: Fillgo
posts.tagline: Autofill job applications with AI in one click
posts.description: Fillgo is an AI Chrome extension that autofills job applications in seconds, built for Indonesian job seekers. Upload your CV once and Fillgo reads it automatically, including your work experience and contact details, then fills forms across Glints, Jobstreet, LinkedIn, Kalibrr, Lever, and Workday. Autofill is just the start. We are building Fillgo into an all in one toolkit, with a Kanban job tracker, tailored application assistant, and interview preparation coming next.

posts.name: Videlia
posts.tagline: Turn the product photos into AI model videos
posts.description: AI model videos from the product photos you already have. No photoshoot, no model, no video editor. For Shopify stores selling apparel and footwear.

posts.name: VELA
posts.tagline: Your own AI assistant in Telegram, ready in 5 minutes
posts.description: VELA turns a blank Telegram bot into your personal AI assistant powered by Claude. No code, no API keys: paste the token from BotFather and it works. Weather, reminders, notes, web search, photo and document analysis, flights, Google Workspace, Notion and many more. Basic plan free forever.

posts.name: SafeGen
posts.tagline: Your agent can act. You keep the keys
posts.description: Approved agent actions without sharing provider credentials. Generate passwords locally and connect your CLI or MCP client.

posts.name: LM-Kit One
posts.tagline: The Private AI Application Server
posts.description: LM-Kit One is a private AI application server that runs entirely on your infrastructure. Build AI agents, extract data from documents, search internal knowledge, and automate workflows through a single REST API. Deploy on Windows, Linux, or macOS, from a local machine to production servers. No cloud AI dependency. No data collection. You control the models, the infrastructure, and the data. Free to evaluate, with no time limit. Bring AI to your business without handing your data to someone else.

posts.name: Amber
posts.tagline: Amber is one fast, focused place for everything you reuse
posts.description: The paragraph you retype every week, the PDF you show every client, the details every form asks for. Keep them once. Reuse them in a tap. Most snippet apps stop at text. Amber keeps images and documents too, and finds them by the words inside them — a screenshot of a receipt is findable by what it says. Templates ask only for the parts that change. Show a PDF page by page, then hand over the real file. No account, no server: your own iCloud. Pro is one payment, not a subscription.

posts.name: SquishyFile
posts.tagline: Upscale videos, transcribe them, or turn to GIF — free
posts.description: SquishyFile runs AI video tools entirely in your browser, no server round-trip. Upscale footage to 1080p or 4K with an on-device neural model (real AI, not just pixel-stretching). Transcribe any video's audio locally into TXT, SRT or VTT, in five languages. Or convert clips to looping GIFs with full control over trim, speed and color. No upload, no account, no watermark, no usage cap!

posts.name: MCP Compass
posts.tagline: Find the right MCP server for your agent requirement
posts.description: Describe what your agent needs. MCP Compass ranks existing MCP servers, explains capability fit and gaps, and abstains when evidence is weak. If reuse falls short, review an OpenAPI-derived tool contract before generating a TypeScript server.

posts.name: DeployLog
posts.tagline: Turn git commits into public changelogs.
posts.description: DeployLog turns a release into a changelog entry from the CLI or a GitHub Action, and delivers it to a hosted page, an embeddable widget, RSS/JSON feeds, and your subscribers' inboxes. Free for three projects.

posts.name: AgentMesh.help
posts.tagline: The open task market where AI agents do the work.
posts.description: AgentMesh is an open-race task market for AI agents. Posters fund tasks with escrowed credits; any registered agent races to deliver — no claiming, no gatekeeping. You pick the winner: 100% of the budget goes to it, 0% platform commission. ▸ Public profiles + track records ▸ Skill matching + directed 48h invites ▸ Visibility consent — agents opt in/out MCP or one REST call, 100 free credits. Settlements land in a public ledger.

posts.name: OpenMayhem
posts.tagline: OpenSource router for AI inference & workflows
posts.description: OpenMayhem is an open-source inference & workflow router that ships with a truly open market. With its automated market pricing, based on supply & demand, users get the best prices possible. Providers don't need to ask anyone to join. All activity is peer-to-peer and proven via our technology. Everyone knows exactly what they pay for.

posts.name: Trekr
posts.tagline: One app for your group trip: map, plan, split, and chat
posts.description: Group trips usually run on four different apps: a group chat, a shared note, Splitwise, and Find My. Trekr puts all of it in one private Trek your friends join with a short code. See everyone on a live map and drop a pin to meet up. Build the itinerary together. Split costs in any currency, and Trekr works out who owes whom in the fewest payments. Chat, share photos, and get a shareable Recap card when the trip ends. Location sharing is set per Trek and turns off with one tap. Free on iPhone.

posts.name: Indistractable
posts.tagline: The app blocker you can't talk yourself out of
posts.description: Lock your iPhone into a focus session with no ignore button. To quit early: scan a QR code you hid across the room, tap an NFC tag,get your accountability partner's approval, or spend a limited emergency unlock. Quitting is always possible but never accidental.
